1.title: 概覽
content: 身為黑爪的領袖，同時也是《鬥陣特攻》的主要反派，他更是所有後排玩家的夢魘。![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）是遊戲中最頂尖的干擾者與騷擾者之一。配備了多種位移技能，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）極難被鎖定，且能隨時突襲你的位置。

他的擊退效果與範圍傷害（AoE damage）使敵人難以推進，而他的機動性則讓他能輕易逼近對手。通常來說，玩家若想壓制一名技術高超的![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）玩家，唯一的辦法就是選出多名能直接克制他的英雄，或是擁有大量控場技能的角色。
雖然他不擅長爭奪目標點或在咽喉點（choke points）擔任前線，但他刺殺敵方後排的能力足以彌補這些弱點。

1.1.1.title: 遊玩方式
content: * 利用你優越的機動性快速進場與撤離。![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王應該不斷干擾敵人並阻礙他們的攻勢。

* 務必保留一項技能（火箭拳、裂地重拳或強力格擋）來保命或從你的突襲中撤離。將三項技能全部傾瀉在滿血的隊伍身上只會導致![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王送頭。

* 追蹤敵方的暈眩技能，例如![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢，並選擇以裂地重拳取消強力格擋來閃避，或是除非你已經看過對方使用過該暈眩技能，否則不要輕易進行格擋。

1.1.2.title: 對戰策略
content: * 當他正在格擋或蓄力 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）時，請使用暈眩技能。他此時處於靜止狀態，而中斷他的 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強力格擋（Power Block）是擊殺 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）的最佳方法。

* 閃避他的進場攻擊。隨時留意 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）的位置，並觀察他何時使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)地震波（Seismic Slam）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）切入。如果你能閃避他的首波攻擊，他將無法獲得額外生命值，並被迫撤退重整。

* 若要反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist），請選擇具備暈眩技能的英雄，或是能閃避他的高機動性英雄。如果你無法逃脫或暈眩他，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）將會在整場比賽中不斷騷擾你。

2.title: 優勢與劣勢總結
content: * 高機動性
* 控場（CC）
* 干擾手段
* 容易受控場（CC）影響
* 近戰
* 操作難度高

3.1.1.title: 超高機動性
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）擁有頻繁使用的機動工具，能同時進行水平與垂直方向的位移。對![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）而言，沒有任何地方是安全的。他能迅速穿越地圖、繞過敵方前線，或是撤退至安全區域。

3.1.2.title: 群體控制
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）的冷卻時間僅有 4 秒，且可以透過 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強力格擋（Power Block）立即重置。![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）擁有比其他任何英雄更頻繁的擊退能力。他非常擅長透過不斷地迫使敵人位移來控制戰場空間。

3.1.3.title: 干擾
content: 即使 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王沒有成功擊殺目標，他的存在本身就具有極強的干擾性。當他突襲一名英雄或一群敵人時，對方必須交出冷卻技能來進行反擊。他會吸引大量的注意力，而在敵人分心的這段期間，他的隊友將有更多機會打出關鍵的操作。

3.2.1.title: 容易受到暈眩影響
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)動力格擋（Power Block）雖然具有傷害減免效果，但毀滅拳王（Doomfist）並沒有任何手段可以真正格擋暈眩效果。在他引導技能期間，他的移動速度極慢，很容易成為目標。由於他最強的招式都依賴於位移，因此對 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）施加暈眩效果能有效地限制他的發揮。

3.2.2.title: 近戰英雄
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）技能組的主要限制因素在於他本質上是一名近戰英雄。![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon）雖然賦予了他些許遠程與騷擾能力，但這更多是用來輔助提升 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）與 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)地震波（Seismic Slam）殺傷力的手段。![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王必須極度貼近目標，這也使他暴露在極大的危險之中。

3.2.3.title: 高技術上限
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）屬於那種只有在專精玩家手中才能大放異彩的英雄。如果你只是隨意遊玩 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）且他並非你的本命英雄，那麼請做好迎接許多艱難對局的心理準備。他擁有大量英雄專屬的技術（tech），玩家需要具備極高的遊戲意識來判讀並追蹤敵方的資源。

4.1.title: 主要攻擊：手砲（Hand Cannon）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon）的技巧**
* 射程

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon）的有效射程約為 10 公尺。超過此距離後，彈丸會過於分散，且傷害衰減也會開始生效。
* 騷擾與預判射擊

* * 在投入突襲交戰前，可以使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon）來造成一些騷擾傷害。

* 在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）或 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)裂地重拳（Seismic Slam）之前，務必先發射一到兩發 ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon），以削減敵方生命值並提升總體傷害。
* 自動裝填
* * 請留意你的彈藥量，因為只要你沒有在射擊，主要攻擊就會自動裝填。

* 在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲（Hand Cannon）後，需要經過短暫的冷卻時間才會開始裝填，因此如果你需要更多彈藥，請停止射擊。

4.2.title: 次要攻擊：火箭拳（Rocket Punch）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）技巧
* 以火箭拳（Rocket Punch）開戰

* * 由於火箭拳（Rocket Punch）的冷卻時間短，且強化後的![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）會重置冷卻，當你不需要![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)地震擊（Seismic Slam）的垂直位移能力時，使用![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）來開戰會比使用![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)地震擊（Seismic Slam）更好。
* 在第一波攻擊中成功造成暈眩，也能讓你的後續連段更加容易。
* 撞牆（Wall slams）

* * 你應該隨時嘗試將敵人與他們身後的牆壁或建築物對齊。你可以透過側移或使用![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)地震擊（Seismic Slam）來調整位置，然後將敵人![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）撞向牆壁。
* 保留強化狀態

* * 當你擁有強化後的![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）時，如果沒有好的目標，請透過主要攻擊或使用其他技能來取消施放。不要浪費強化後的![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）非常重要。

4.3.title: [SHIFT]：震地重擊（Seismic Slam）
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊（Seismic Slam）的使用技巧**
* 取得位置

* * 震地重擊非常適合用來跳過牆壁或敵方隊伍，以便為![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭重拳（Rocket Punch）取得有利位置。
* 若你連續使用這兩項技能，請務必確保結束時身處掩體後方，或是敵方隊伍無法擊殺你的位置。
* 脫離戰場

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊的快速移動速度，以及其垂直、對角線與水平移動的能力，使其非常適合用來脫離危險位置。
* 在使用重拳或格擋後，你通常需要透過震地重擊來撤離以保持存活，待敵方資源耗盡後再發動強力進攻。
* 重擊取消

* * 在![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊期間啟動格擋或![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭重拳將會取消該技能，但會保留慣性。垂直使用![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊，接著取消技能，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）便會飛向空中。

4.4.title: [E]：強權格擋（Power Block）
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強權格擋（Power Block）的使用技巧
* 如何提升強化（Empowered）的觸發率

* 等敵人開始攻擊後再使用。不要預判性地使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強權格擋（Power Block），期待敵人會開始攻擊你。

* 格擋飛行速度較慢的投射物，例如 ![](/data/assets/guide/d2aabba10a98f146.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Ffire-strike.png)烈焰擊（Fire Strike）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/98529ba32956dcb8.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fpharah.png)法拉（Pharah）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/ce38aca322038472.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-launcher.png)火箭發射器（Rocket Launcher）。當你看到這些投射物朝你發射時，你有足夠的時間進行格擋。
* 製造壓力。如果你對敵方隊伍構成巨大威脅，他們會集火攻擊你，這會導致格擋吸收更多傷害。
* 誘騙控場技能

* 當你知道敵人試圖對你使用控場技能時，使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊（Seismic Slam）來取消格擋。

* 範例：![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜（Ana）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）冷卻時間是 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強權格擋（Power Block）和 ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)震地重擊（Seismic Slam）的兩倍。因此，你可以使用格擋，在睡眠鏢擊中你之前向側邊使用重擊，這樣當 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜（Ana）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/89ddbbfe1fbc9a6c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fsleep-dart.png)睡眠鏢（Sleep Dart）再次就緒前，你的兩個技能都已經冷卻完畢。
* 承受高傷害絕招

* 存活下來其實才是 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)強權格擋（Power Block）的主要用途。如果你沒有位移技能可以閃躲，就使用格擋來承受像脈衝炸彈（Pulse Bomb）這類的高爆發傷害攻擊。

4.5.title: （被動技能）：最佳防禦……
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/287f9b9e850436af.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fthe-best-defense.png)最佳防禦……的提示**
* 額外生命

* * ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王最多可以產生 200 點額外生命。使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/b2653d3e7fce99bf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmeteor-strike.png)流星擊（Meteor Strike）最容易達成，因為命中每名敵人所產生的護盾更多。

* 產生暫時性護盾是 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王生存的關鍵。請謹慎瞄準你的技能，確保能持續獲得額外生命。如果做不到，你就必須提早脫離戰場。
* 衰減
* * 額外生命在 3 秒後才會開始衰減，且衰減速度緩慢。
* 不要因為擁有額外生命就急於進攻。你仍有時間仔細規劃進攻路徑與目標。
* 僅在造成技能傷害時產生
* * 額外生命並非透過使用技能產生，而是僅能透過技能傷害產生。

* 範例：![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch）若因其他擊倒技能（衝鋒、盾擊、拳擊、B.O.B.）而發生碰撞取消，則不會產生任何額外生命。

4.6.title: 絕招：流星打擊
content: **![](/data/assets/guide/b2653d3e7fce99bf.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fmeteor-strike.png)流星打擊的提示**
* 刷新冷卻時間與生命值
* * 除非遇到一群生命值偏低的敵人聚在一起，否則最好等到你的生命值和冷卻時間都恢復後再發動流星打擊。
* 預判移動
* * 等待並觀察目標的移動方式。他們知道你正在使用絕招，因此會試圖閃避。預測他們移動的方向並選擇該落點。
* 準備閃避

* * 面對擁有投射物暈眩技能的敵人時，他們通常會試圖在 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王落地的瞬間進行攻擊。在這些對戰組合中，考慮在落地後立即使用裂地重拳逃離。
* 視角拉近與拉遠

* * 當視角拉近時，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王會停留在當前的地面高度，或是降落至可到達的最低地面。

* 當視角拉遠時，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王則會移動至目標區域的最高樓層。

5.1.1.title: 一二連擊（One-Two）
5.1.1.description: 使用火箭拳（Rocket Punch）將敵人擊退至牆上時，會填裝所有手砲（Hand Cannon）彈藥，並額外過載填裝 2 發彈藥。
content: * 快速出拳（Quick Punch）

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王在蓄力![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳時會開始自動填裝彈藥，因此當未完全蓄力![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳時，一二連擊（One-Two）對主要攻擊的使用影響最為顯著。

* 將所有![](/data/assets/guide/91a2bc571e74c5b2.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fhand-cannon.png)手砲彈藥傾瀉在敵人身上，快速使用![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳將其擊向牆面，接著用刷新後的次要攻擊收掉敵人，最後使用裂地重拳（Seismic Slam）撤離。

* 與![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳搭配效果極佳

* * 因為你不必花時間蓄力強化後的![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳，一二連擊（One-Two）能為你提供快速的爆發傷害潛力。

5.1.2.title: 適者生存 (Survival of the Fittest)
5.1.2.description: 「最佳防禦（The Best Defense）」在擊殺後會賦予 25 點額外生命，且其額外生命上限增加 50 點。
content: * 整體而言比「一二連擊（One-Two）」稍弱

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）能獲得大量擊殺

* * 由於他擁有範圍傷害（AoE）技能，且你的隊伍會跟進你的開戰，大部分隊伍取得的擊殺都會有 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）的傷害助攻，並計入擊殺以獲得額外生命。
* 若你的隊伍處於劣勢則不推薦
* * 當你需要更多單人操作的發揮空間時，選擇「一二連擊（One-Two）」會更好。
* 當你的隊伍無法取得大量擊殺時，選擇「適者生存（Survival of the Fittest）」將無法獲得太多效益

5.2.1.title: 餘震（Aftershock）
5.2.1.description: 被震地攻擊（Seismic Slam）擊中的敵人會被緩速 40%，持續 2 秒。
content: * 餘震（Aftershock）的問題在於你必須放棄能量矩陣（Power Matrix）。只有在敵方隊伍沒有投射物暈眩技能時，才選擇這個特殊能力（perk）。
* 使用震地攻擊（Seismic Slam）開戰，這樣你在緩速期間可以輕鬆進行後續射擊。理想情況下，你應該已經擁有強化拳擊（empowered punch），這樣就能輕鬆擊殺對手。

5.2.2.title: 能量矩陣（Power Matrix）
5.2.2.description: 能量格擋（Power Block）在持續時間的前一秒內會吸收投射物。
content: * 最佳主要特殊能力（Major Perk）
* 創造新的反制手段

* * 先前我們曾提到 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）特別容易受到暈眩效果的影響。能量矩陣（Power Matrix）賦予了他反制暈眩的能力。只要時機掌握得當，能量矩陣（Power Matrix）就能吸收並抵銷所有投射物。
* 與防禦矩陣（Defensive Matrix）擁有相同的反制手段

* * 很遺憾，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）在使用 ![](/data/assets/guide/1fda4cd48050e83c.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fpower-block.png)能量格擋（Power Block）時並非完全無敵。諸如 ![](/data/assets/guide/492c99cc430727c1.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Froadhog.png)攔路豬（Roadhog）的「肉鉤（Hook）」、![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王（Doomfist）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)火箭拳（Rocket Punch），以及 ![](/data/assets/guide/b07e1a5d33e34f21.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fsigma.png)席格馬（Sigma）的 ![](/data/assets/guide/b87166103290a2c3.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Faccretion.png)吸積（Accretion）等技能依然能反制能量矩陣（Power Matrix）。

6.title: 地圖
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist and his incredible mobility are best utilized on maps where teams tend to play spread out. The only thing he requires is natural cover to rotate around. ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)Doomfist typically takes space in chunks so long sight lines and wide open areas are difficult for him. Tight areas with lots of walls and structures give him more opportunities for wall slams off ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch which greatly raises his overall impact. Additionally, his knockback is quite far so maps with nearby ledges give him the chance for environmental kills.

7.title: 隊伍陣容搭配
content: 以 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王 為核心的理想隊伍陣容，旨在發揮他爆發性的遊玩風格。![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王的遊戲循環會在進場與撤退之間不斷切換。擁有相似風格或具備高價值爆發能力的英雄是與他搭配的最佳選擇。

基本上，每一種 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王 陣容都會運用以他發起的攻擊為錨點的側襲者（Flanker）風格。多虧了他的格擋與額外生命值，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王 相當自給自足，因此他不需要大量的治療資源，這為支援角色的搭配提供了更多的靈活性。

7.1.title: 與其他英雄的個人搭配
content: ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅 (6v6 遊戲模式)

* ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅與 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王的技能組在 6v6 格式中能完美互補。當 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王受到 ![](/data/assets/guide/edfc9d8a2457aafb.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fprojected-barrier.png)投射屏障（Projected Barrier）的保護時，他激進的突進會變得更加致命且穩定。如果敵人因為屏障而無法對正在衝鋒的 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王施加控場效果（CC），他將非常難以被擊倒。他們的大絕也是絕佳的組合，因為 ![](/data/assets/guide/eacdf2c5d0a248f5.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fgraviton-surge.png)重力噴湧（Graviton Surge）能將敵人固定在原地，讓 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王進行重擊。

* 他們採取分開作戰的打法，由 ![](/data/assets/guide/530a84fb4af55362.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fzarya.png)札莉雅負責穩住前線，而 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王則負責騷擾後排。
![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏

* ![](/data/assets/guide/c5e996565ab1a764.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fgenji.png)源氏與 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王要帶領隊伍獲勝，唯一需要的就是一點默契。只要他們能抓準攻擊時機並鎖定同一名敵人，就能迅速為隊伍取得人數優勢。或者，其中一人可以在敵方隊伍為了在第一波攻擊中存活而交出防禦資源後，再跟進補刀。
![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜

* ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜的遠程治療與傷害能支援 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王的深入突進。只要她成功命中禁療效果，![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王通常就能確保擊殺，除非敵人使用了無敵或淨化技能。

* ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王也是奈米強化（Nano Boost）的絕佳目標，可以在強化期間取得多次擊殺。最後，每當 ![](/data/assets/guide/3bd1f9f730a6a2ce.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fana.png)安娜使某人陷入沉睡，且 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王擁有大絕時，那將是保證擊殺的機會。

8.title: 如何反制
content: 若要反制 ![](/data/assets/guide/b0e3b7fdf5d7ba15.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fheroes%2Fdoomfist.png)毀滅拳王，群體控制技能幾乎是必備的。若要在沒有暈眩技能的情況下對抗毀滅拳王，你必須具備能持續閃避他的機動性。考慮到他是遊戲中機動性最強的英雄之一，這說起來容易做起來難。
除非他目前的生命值低於 20% 左右，或者附近沒有醫護兵（Support）能為他治療，否則絕對不要在他格擋時攻擊他。單純不讓他獲得強化拳擊（Empowered Punch）是存活下來的最佳方式。
最容易暈眩他的時機是在他進行格擋時。如果他開始透過取消格擋並接上震地重擊（Seismic Slam）來誘騙你的技能，這就是一場博弈，看誰會先浪費掉自己的技能。

The other best time is while he channels ![](/data/assets/guide/07a6c392a4903511.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Frocket-punch.png)Rocket Punch, or immediately after he uses ![](/data/assets/guide/177c26faed388178.png#fallback=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.mobalytics.gg%2Fcdn-cgi%2Fimage%2Fformat%3Dauto%2Cwidth%3D96%2Fassets%2Foverwatch%2Fimages%2Fabilities%2Fseismic-slam.png)Seismic Slam since you know he won't be able to suddenly move unless he uses his ultimate.
